source.description: Reviewed v2 handmade raster contact sheet for a targeted process repair; the existing finished master remains the intended visual destination.
source.notes: The original v1 process sheet is superseded privately because its disconnected construction, floating apple, and unassigned U-curves did not teach the final object. The repair locks a connected bag guide and a zipper-attached apple relationship.

process_strategy: Six cumulative panels retain one centered backpack: connected construction box, finished bag body, two outer straps plus upper flap, pocket and zipper-attached apple, ink/color map, then finish-only fills.

progression_contract.blank_page_test: A beginner can copy Panel 1 in under two minutes using one light connected rounded-rectangle construction box, one centerline, one pocket box, two shoulder ticks, and one right-pocket zipper anchor tick.

anchor_map.early_mark: One light connected rounded-rectangle construction box
anchor_map.becomes: The centered backpack body and its short top handle
anchor_map.fixed_relationship: The box keeps the final bag width, height, lower corners, and centerline; the finished body is drawn directly over it without shifting.
anchor_map.construction_note: This is an allowed closed primitive, visibly pale and simple rather than a finished outer contour.

anchor_map.becomes: Exactly two curved shoulder straps behind the left and right sides of the bag
anchor_map.fixed_relationship: Each strap begins at its own upper shoulder tick, arcs outside the body, and returns to the same lower outer side without turning into an inner U-curve.
anchor_map.construction_note: These are ticks only in Panel 1; closed strap edges first appear in Panel 3.

anchor_map.early_mark: One lower-front pocket box and right-pocket zipper anchor tick
anchor_map.becomes: One rounded front pocket with zipper seam, pull, and apple-keychain loop
anchor_map.fixed_relationship: The pocket stays centered low on the bag; the zipper pull and apple loop attach at its upper-right corner in every panel where they appear.
anchor_map.construction_note: The pocket box is a pale proportion guide; the zipper and apple are absent until their feature stage.

anchor_map.becomes: One small red apple keychain with one green leaf
anchor_map.fixed_relationship: The apple hangs immediately beside and partly overlaps the bag's lower-right edge from the zipper pull; it never floats away from that anchor.
anchor_map.construction_note: Only the attachment tick appears early; the apple circle, loop, and leaf first appear together in Panel 4.

final_elements.name: backpack body
final_elements.description: One upright centered coral school backpack with a connected rounded body and short top handle.

final_elements.name: shoulder straps and flap
final_elements.description: Exactly two outer curved shoulder straps behind the bag plus one upper rounded yellow flap.

final_elements.name: front pocket and zipper
final_elements.description: One lower rounded teal front pocket with one curved zipper seam and a short pull at the upper-right corner.

final_elements.name: apple keychain
final_elements.description: One small red apple with one green leaf hanging from the pocket zipper pull beside the lower-right bag edge.

final_elements.name: highlights and ground shadow
final_elements.description: Two open-paper highlights on established bag regions and one short broken navy ground shadow.

final_elements.name: marker palette
final_elements.description: Black keeper outlines plus coral body, yellow flap, teal pocket, red apple, green leaf, and navy shadow regions.

overlap_reservations.background_lines_stop_before: The body guide is a simple outer box only; no keeper seams cross the reserved lower-front pocket footprint.
The right-pocket zipper anchor tick reserves the apple loop and overlap beside the body before any zipper seam is drawn.

frames.visible_job: Place one light connected rounded-rectangle construction box, one vertical centerline, one lower-front pocket box, two upper outer-shoulder ticks, and one right-pocket zipper anchor tick.
construction_primitives: one light connected rounded-rectangle construction box
adds: strap and keychain attachment locations without future contours
must_not_show: black marker outlines or marker color

frames.visible_job: Draw one finished rounded bag body and short top handle directly over the connected guide, preserving the pocket box and all three attachment locations.

frames.step_name: Add the outer straps and flap
frames.visible_job: Draw exactly two outer shoulder straps from the established shoulder ticks and one upper rounded flap, leaving the pocket and keychain as the same guides.

frames.step_name: Draw the pocket and attached apple
frames.visible_job: Turn the lower guide into one rounded front pocket with one zipper seam and pull, then hang one apple with one leaf directly from that pull at the reserved right-side anchor.
adds: two highlight reserves and one broken shadow route
must_not_show: new books pencils face or lettering

frames.visible_job: Ink only established contours, then map visible coral, yellow, teal, red, green, and navy marker strokes in every planned region without changing anchors or adding forms.
adds: one thick imperfect black keeper-line pass
visible color in every planned region
must_not_show: moved apple or changed strap attachments
new books pencils face or lettering

final_step.visible_job: Only complete the established marker fills, strengthen selected keeper contours, and add small highlight and shadow accents.

rejection_checks: Reject a disconnected main construction box that cannot directly support the body silhouette.
Reject an apple or zipper pull that shifts from its early right-pocket anchor or does not visibly connect.
Reject U-curves or routes that do not become exactly two outer straps or the one upper flap with the same direction and endpoints.
Reject any frame that moves a previously visible construction relationship instead of refining it.
Reject vector-like finish or non-cumulative redraw.
